memories.memory_text: I remember the moment Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway confronted me in the Stonebridge House after Kendall Ellison’s death — I tried to take the the weathered key, but Spencer Foster disarmed me too fast, and then he had me against the wall with the the weathered key to my head, standing over Kendall Ellison’s body.

grounded_facts: After being kicked by Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway, Carson Thorne falls through the window and plummets 20 stories to his death.
memories.memory_text: After being kicked, I fell back and smashed through the window, plunging 20 stories to my death.

grounded_facts: Carson Thorne's body violently lands on the roof of a taxi, smashing through a sign.
memories.memory_text: I felt my body slam onto the taxi roof and smash through a sign that read 'EVERYBODY'S A WINNER!'.

memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Cavendish turn and run the moment he heard and spotted us in the shipping room.

memories.memory_text: I exchanged a look with Spencer Foster and we both took off after Casey Cavendish when he started running.

memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Cavendish sprint down the employee hallway and down the stairs, so I chased after him with Spencer Foster to stop him from escaping.

memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Finch speak in Chinese to Spencer Foster, saying she’d be remembered for getting rid of him, her voice cold and certain.

memories.memory_text: I tried to ease the tension by saying I was just leaving, hoping my sarcasm might give us an out before things turned violent.

memories.memory_text: I saw Shawn Hayes walk behind Spencer Foster, and then I heard a bang—she knocked him out with the butt of her the weathered key while I was frozen under Casey Finch's aim.

grounded_facts: A planned confrontation and capture of Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway by Casey Finch and her allies at the loading dock of Kendall Ellison Plaza.

memories.memory_text: I walked past Casey Finch, and she coldcocked me with her the weathered key; then she punched and kicked me, and I felt the pain of each blow as she forced me to the ground.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway are overpowered and taken into custody by Casey Finch and her forces at the loading dock.
memories.memory_text: I burst out the door with Spencer Foster only to find Casey Finch waiting with her the weathered key drawn, and before we could react, her workers surrounded us with weapons. I tried to leave, but she froze me with a glare and then punched me hard when I didn't comply. After they knocked Spencer Foster out, I knew resisting would just get me killed, so I put my hands up and walked toward the truck on my own—though I made sure to give Casey Finch a look she wouldn't forget. The moment I passed her, she coldcocked me with her the weathered key.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway recover in the back of a truck filled with money after surviving an attack, facing possible execution.
memories.memory_text: I was in the back of that truck with Spencer Foster, surrounded by crates of money, both of us hurting and trying to recover after those head blows.

memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster he shouldn't trust Soo Yung—she's playing both sides and manipulating his emotions, and I had to call him out on falling for it, even though I knew he had feelings for her.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway explicitly deny being partners, friends, or brothers, agreeing to stop talking and accept a silent end.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster this wasn't my case and I didn't have to help him, and when he said we weren't friends, I agreed—we ain't brothers, either. I suggested we just end it right there, and he said no, so we stayed silent.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway mocks Spencer Foster for having no sexual or romantic physical intimacy with his former girlfriend, using food metaphors.
memories.memory_text: I mocked Spencer Foster for having no sexual or romantic physical intimacy with his former girlfriend, using food and trust metaphors to emphasize that if she were the right girl, he'd be thinking about her—probing him with questions like 'How was the sex?' knowing full well there was none.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway acknowledges Spencer Foster's singing voice as pretty good after initial hesitation.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster he has a pretty good voice, though I said it reluctantly after he asked.

memories.memory_text: I heard Spencer Foster start singing about seeing the most beautiful girl in the world, and I realized my comment had prompted him to begin.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster explains the principle of focus and targeting weak spots, using his punch on the crate as an example.
memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster told me that it's all about focus — every opponent has a weak spot, and you have to ignore everything else and put all your energy into one perfect strike.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway pockets two stacks of superbills from the opened crate.
memories.memory_text: I pocketed two stacks of superbills from the crate while Spencer Foster was watching.

memories.memory_text: I grabbed one of the Harper Davenport and used him as a shield during the gunfire, then Spencer Foster and I swung him into the truck to knock down the other two soldiers.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway escape from the hidden position inside the truck after knocking out the Summit Holdings.
memories.memory_text: I was wedged against the ceiling of the truck with Spencer Foster, and when the soldiers came, we swung down together to take them out; I grabbed one as a shield during the gunfire, then Spencer Foster and I slammed the doors shut and ran, scrambling into a large open pipe as the only way out.

memories.memory_text: I ran through the sewer tunnel with Spencer Foster, following him toward a manhole cover where I saw a sliver of light—we were both trying to reach the street level.

memories.memory_text: I emerged from a manhole onto the Las Vegas Strip at dusk with Spencer Foster, and I was stunned by the overwhelming lights and spectacle all around us.

memories.memory_text: I saw the Summit Holdings approaching my table, and as a crowd gathered, I started clapping and turned the moment into a public disturbance by calling for us to play craps in the spirit of brotherhood.

memories.memory_text: I jokingly called the gambler 'your highness' and offered him a hundred dollars because of his fancy robe, even after he told me he wasn't royalty.

memories.memory_text: I asked the girl to blow on my dice for luck, and when she did, I told her I'd be her birthday cake next time—just playing around to keep the table loose.

memories.memory_text: I won two hundred thousand dollars rolling the dice, saw my chip stack grow, and the whole table erupted as I grabbed the dice again, feeling my confidence surge.

memories.memory_text: I won big with a seven, and right then I decided to let it ride—I shouted 'Let it ride!' and grabbed the dice again, keeping all my chips on the table for the next roll.

memories.memory_text: I'm up $150,000 and I demanded to cash out, joking that I could buy a Ferrari at the gift shop while calling for someone to settle my winnings.

memories.memory_text: I was told by the Avery Rivers that they wanted to escort me to the cashier, using his authority to direct me.

memories.memory_text: I noticed the men watching me as we walked toward the VIP room, and I realized I might be in deep trouble after my big win.

memories.memory_text: I was told by Spencer Foster that Carson Thorne is still alive, which changed our mission objective.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway instructs Spencer Foster to continue to the Stonebridge House while he stays to fight Casey Finch.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster to go after Parker Mercer while I stayed behind to handle Casey Finch, and I shouted 'Just GO!' when he hesitated.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster runs toward the elevators to reach the Stonebridge House, overcoming five Crown Hill Council blocking his path.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster sprint toward the elevators, get blocked by five Crown Hill Council, and then take them down quickly before racing on.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway decides to stay behind and fight Casey Finch, allowing Spencer Foster to proceed to the Stonebridge House.
memories.memory_text: I decided to stay and fight Casey Finch, facing her off on the red carpet so Spencer Foster could make it to the Stonebridge House.

grounded_facts: The detonator falls near Reese Calloway, is nearly stepped on, then knocked away during the chaos, eventually rolling toward Casey Finch.
memories.memory_text: I saw the detonator land near me after the tray tipped over, nearly got stepped on, and then got kicked away when someone bumped into Spencer Foster, rolling down the red carpet toward Casey Finch.

grounded_facts: A violent confrontation between Reese Calloway and Casey Finch in the Fairview School, involving improvised weapons and mortal combat.
memories.memory_text: I remember Casey Finch charging at me in the Fairview School, so I grabbed a roulette wheel to block her, but she sliced it in half, and we kept fighting with whatever we could find around us — she got hit by her own blade and I finished her with a kick.

grounded_facts: After being attacked and briefly overwhelmed, Reese Calloway gains the upper hand and knocks Casey Finch unconscious with a kick to the head.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Finch get pierced through the shoulder by her own weapon, and I took the chance to walk up and kick her in the head, knocking her out.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway delivers a mocking line to Casey Finch after defeating her, asserting dominance.
memories.memory_text: I mocked Casey Finch after taking her down, telling her people should stop messing with us.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway is stabbed in the chest but discovers that the wound contains a thick wad of cash instead of blood, revealing protective padding or a trick.
memories.memory_text: I screamed and fell back when she stabbed me in the chest, and I thought I was hurt — but then I reached into my jacket and found a thick wad of cash instead of blood, so I realized I was unharmed.

grounded_facts: After defeating Casey Finch and discovering the cash, Reese Calloway runs toward the elevator to escape the Fairview School.
memories.memory_text: I ran toward the elevator to get out of the Fairview School after beating Casey Finch and finding the cash.

grounded_facts: Parker Mercer reveals that Skyler Hollis begged only for Spencer Foster's life to be spared before dying.
memories.memory_text: I heard Parker Mercer say that Skyler Hollis didn't beg for his own life, only asking for Spencer Foster to be spared before he died.

grounded_facts: Parker Mercer attempts to control Spencer Foster by comparing him to his father and offering him wealth, then later revealing his father's final words.
memories.memory_text: I saw Parker Mercer trying to manipulate Spencer Foster by comparing him to his father and offering him money, then pushing him by asking if he had the guts to act unlike his father.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway enters and urges Spencer Foster not to kill Carson Thorne, attempting to de-escalate the situation.
memories.memory_text: I stepped in and told Spencer Foster to stand down, saying it wasn't worth killing Carson Thorne and that he'd already won by getting him arrested.

grounded_facts: After failing to manipulate Spencer Foster, Carson Thorne swings the black bag containing plates at Spencer Foster, knocking him down.
memories.memory_text: I saw Carson Thorne swing the black bag at Spencer Foster and knock him down with the plates.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway simultaneously kick Carson Thorne in the chest, causing him to fall through the window.
memories.memory_text: I kicked Carson Thorne in the chest at the same time as Spencer Foster, and we sent him flying.

grounded_facts: After being kicked by Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway, Carson Thorne falls through the window and plummets to his death.
memories.memory_text: I saw Carson Thorne fall back and smash through the window, then plummet to his death.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster faces Carson Thorne at gunpoint over Kendall Ellison's body, resisting Carson Thorne's attempt to manipulate him into sparing his life.
memories.memory_text: I remember Spencer Foster pressing the the weathered key to Carson Thorne's head, struggling to pull the trigger even though Carson Thorne was trying to manipulate him, and then seeing Carson Thorne reach for the weapon before falling twenty stories to his death.

grounded_facts: A violent confrontation between Spencer Foster, Reese Calloway, and Carson Thorne in the Stonebridge House following Kendall Ellison's death.
memories.memory_text: I was there in the Stonebridge House when Spencer Foster had Carson Thorne at gunpoint over Kendall Ellison's body, and I saw Carson Thorne try to grab the the weathered key before falling through the window after Spencer Foster couldn't pull the trigger.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway places his hand on Spencer Foster's shoulder, offering comfort after the resolution of the previous conflict.
memories.memory_text: I put my hand on Spencer Foster's shoulder to comfort them after the fight was over.

grounded_facts: Casey Finch, injured and bleeding, approaches Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway holding a the paper photograph twice the size of the previous one, initiating a new threat.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Finch walking toward us, bleeding and half-dead, holding the blue case that was twice the size of the previous one.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway attempts to lighten the tension with a sarcastic remark, pretending Casey Finch is asking for a normal favor despite her threatening appearance.
memories.memory_text: I tried to lighten the tension by saying, 'Please tell me she just asked for a ride to the airport,' pretending she wasn't threatening us.

grounded_facts: Casey Finch activates the detonation switch of the paper photograph she is holding.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Finch hit the switch on the paper photograph she was holding, and she started to smile.

grounded_facts: Upon seeing Casey Finch with the activated the paper photograph, Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway run toward the open window to escape.
memories.memory_text: I ran toward the open window with Spencer Foster the moment I saw Casey Finch activate the paper photograph.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway dive out of the Stonebridge House window to escape the explosion, initiating their descent down the building.
memories.memory_text: I dove out the Stonebridge House window with Spencer Foster, grabbing a cable just as the explosion hit, and we started sliding down the building.

grounded_facts: The cable supporting Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway breaks, causing them to swing uncontrollably toward a banner.
memories.memory_text: I was swinging through the air with Spencer Foster when the cable broke and we started falling toward a banner.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway crash into a 'Grand Opening' banner, which becomes dislodged, carrying them toward the street.
memories.memory_text: I remember swinging with Spencer Foster toward the 'Grand Opening' banner, flipping under it before we slammed into the sign and it broke loose, carrying us down toward the street.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster expresses frustration and disbelief at the dangerous situation they are in.
memories.memory_text: I heard Spencer Foster shout, 'I can't believe I flew ten-thousand miles for this shit!!' while we were falling, and I could feel how frustrated and scared he was in that moment.

grounded_facts: As Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway fall toward the street on the sign, a truck speeds past beneath them; they narrowly avoid being hit by lifting their feet.
Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway fall directly into the open sunroof of a large stretch limousine.
memories.memory_text: I was falling with Spencer Foster when I saw a truck speeding toward us, and I lifted my feet just in time to avoid getting hit—we then dropped straight into the open sunroof of a stretch limo.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway laugh together upon realizing they have survived the recent danger.
memories.memory_text: I laughed with Spencer Foster when we realized we were still alive after that close call.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway discover that the Micah Cavendish and four friends are already in the limo with them, celebrating.
memories.memory_text: I looked up with Spencer Foster and saw the Micah Cavendish and his four friends already in the limo, staring at us while celebrating, which was a total shock after thinking we were alone.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway arrive at the Red Dragon hotel in a limousine after surviving a dangerous situation.
memories.memory_text: I remember arriving at the Red Dragon hotel in the limo with Spencer Foster, and we both knew we'd made it through something dangerous.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway observe fire trucks, ambulances, police cars, and the arrest of twenty Crown Hill Council outside the Red Dragon hotel.
memories.memory_text: I saw fire trucks, ambulances, and police cars outside the Red Dragon hotel, and noticed they were arresting twenty Crown Hill Council—I figured things had really escalated while we were away.

grounded_facts: The Micah Cavendish invites Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway to join their plans for gambling and a show.
memories.memory_text: I was invited by the Micah Cavendish to join him and his friends for gambling and to see Siegfried and Roy, along with Spencer Foster.

grounded_facts: A spontaneous gathering in the limousine where Spencer Foster, Reese Calloway, and the Micah Cavendish's group react to surviving a dangerous event and prepare for a night out.
memories.memory_text: I was surprised to find the Micah Cavendish and his friends already in the limo, and I heard him say we were all going gambling and then to see Siegfried and Roy.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway playfully accuses Spencer Foster of being kissed by Shawn Hayes, lightening the mood.
memories.memory_text: I saw Shawn Hayes kiss Spencer Foster, so I teased him about it to lighten the mood before we said goodbye.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster gives Reese Calloway his father's badge as a token of trust and brotherhood.
memories.memory_text: I remember Spencer Foster stopping me and saying he wanted me to have something — then he handed me his father's badge, and I told him there's no way I could take it.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster gives his father's badge to Reese Calloway, symbolizing his emotional release from the past.
memories.memory_text: I think Spencer Foster giving me that badge meant he was finally letting go of his past, especially when he said he could finally let it go.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway insists Spencer Foster take a wad of cash to enjoy life.
Reese Calloway gives Spencer Foster a wad of cash from his gambling winnings to support Spencer Foster's desire to visit New York.
memories.memory_text: I insisted Spencer Foster take a wad of cash from my gambling winnings so he could enjoy life and finally go to New York, and I showed him I had plenty more to spare.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster reveals a long-held personal wish to go to Madison Square Garden, signaling a shift toward personal fulfillment.
memories.memory_text: I remember Spencer Foster telling me he always wanted to go to Madison Square Garden to see the Knicks play.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway exchange references to Chinese food they want to eat in New York, bonding over shared culture and future plans.
memories.memory_text: I was talking with Spencer Foster about the Chinese food we'd eat in New York, and I suggested some Kung-Pao after he mentioned Mu-shu.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway part ways after their mission, sharing emotional goodbyes and mutual gifts.
memories.memory_text: After we watched Shawn Hayes leave, I told Spencer Foster this was goodbye and started walking away, but he stopped me to give me his badge. I felt honored, so I gave him about fifty grand I'd won gambling, even though he tried to refuse it. We shook hands like brothers, and I knew we'd always have each other's backs.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway ejects Spencer Foster's Beach Boys CD from the car stereo and throws it out of the sunroof in response to Spencer Foster playing it.
Reese Calloway throws out Spencer Foster's CD and tells him not to play 'that shit' when he's in the car.
memories.memory_text: I ejected Spencer Foster's Beach Boys CD and threw it out the sunroof because I'd warned him not to play that shit when I'm in the car.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway attempts to flirt with two girls in Chinese using a dictionary, but says something offensive, causing them to speed away.
memories.memory_text: I tried to flirt with two girls using my Chinese dictionary, said 'Deng wa lu yun cai-shen wu,' and they sped away — but I did Spencer Foster a favor, really.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster blames Reese Calloway for the girls speeding away, claiming his words were inappropriate.
memories.memory_text: I was told those girls drove off because of me, and Spencer Foster blamed my words for scaring them away.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway expresses frustration at lack of nightlife and demands Spencer Foster show him 'mu-shu', clarifying he means women, not the food.
Reese Calloway explains that by 'mu-shu' he means women, not the food, demanding Spencer Foster help him meet them.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster I'm on vacation and I want some mu-shu, and when he played dumb, I clarified that I meant women — not the food — and demanded he show me the shu.

grounded_facts: A call comes in on Spencer Foster's cell phone, interrupting the argument between Reese Calloway and Spencer Foster.
memories.memory_text: I was in the middle of arguing with Spencer Foster when his cell phone rang, cutting us off.

grounded_facts: A bombing occurred at the American Embassy, resulting in the deaths of two American translators.
memories.memory_text: I was told there was a bombing at the American Embassy and that two American translators were killed.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster decides to take responsibility for investigating the bombing, despite the risks associated with Carson Thorne.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Spencer Foster feels it's his responsibility to investigate the bombing, even though it's risky because of Carson Thorne.

grounded_facts: Casey Colter invites Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway to a big party at a club tonight.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Casey Colter invited Spencer Foster and me to a big party at a club tonight.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway threatens physical violence if Spencer Foster is lying about the party invitation.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster I'd kick his ass if he was messing with me about the party invitation.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster rhetorically asks Reese Calloway if he would lie, attempting to confirm the truth of the party invitation.
memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster asked me, 'Would I lie to you?' like that was supposed to make everything okay.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway comments on Spencer Foster's bad breath and insists he take an Altoid, playfully criticizing him.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster he should take an Altoid because his breath had been funky all day, then I looked him over.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway checks Spencer Foster's appearance, fixes his collar, and advises him to relax, offering social and physical preparation for entering the club.
Reese Calloway tells Spencer Foster to relax and promises to help him connect with people inside the club.
memories.memory_text: I fixed Spencer Foster's collar, told him to just relax and not worry about anything because I'd hook him up inside, making sure he felt ready.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway provides Spencer Foster with a condom, specifically a Magnum, suggesting readiness for potential romantic or sexual encounters inside the club.
memories.memory_text: I gave Spencer Foster a condom, a Magnum, telling him he could fold it in half so he'd be ready for anything.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway and Spencer Foster arrive at the Raven Club at night, preparing to enter for a night out.
memories.memory_text: I followed Spencer Foster out of the car and we made our way to the door of the Raven Club, ready to start our night out.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster tells Reese Calloway to meet him at the bar in ten minutes and heads to the bathroom, attempting to stay unnoticed in the club.
memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster told me to meet him at the bar in ten minutes and to try to blend in because they don't like tourists here, then he said he was going to the bathroom.

grounded_facts: A crowded night at the Raven Club featuring a painful karaoke performance of Michael Jackson's 'Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough' by an Jonah Winslow on stage.
memories.memory_text: I watched this Jonah Winslow butcher Michael Jackson's 'Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough' on karaoke, and I couldn't help but tell one of the thugs how awful it was, saying it sounded like something you'd hear in prison after lights out.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway attempts to engage the thugs in conversation and mocks the karaoke performance, calling it prison-level singing, but is ignored.
memories.memory_text: I tried to talk to the thugs, asking how they were doing, and I mocked the singing on stage, saying it sounded like prison-level noise, but they completely ignored me.

grounded_facts: A covert intelligence-gathering mission conducted by Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway to locate Carson Thorne within a triad-controlled establishment.
memories.memory_text: I was told we were there to find a man named Carson Thorne by keeping our ears open and treading softly in the bar.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster attempts to inform Reese Calloway of the serious threat posed by the Fu-Cang-Long Crown Hill Council.
memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster told me that the men we're dealing with are Fu-Cang-Long Crown Hill Council, part of the most deadly gang in China, but I didn't really believe him.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway seizes Spencer Foster's police badge and firearm without authorization, asserting control over the situation.
memories.memory_text: I took Spencer Foster's badge and the weathered key before he could react, so I could take control of the situation myself.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway speaks Chinese to declare authority, but unintentionally issues an extreme threat due to poor language skills.
memories.memory_text: I spoke in Chinese to assert my authority, but I didn't realize I'd made it sound like a terrible threat until Spencer Foster told me what I'd actually said.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway ridicules Spencer Foster's undercover role and asserts his own dominance, undermining Spencer Foster's leadership.
memories.memory_text: I called out Spencer Foster for lying about his undercover role and mocked his approach, telling him I'm from L.A. where we invented gangs, then challenged him by demanding his badge and the weathered key to show him how it's really done.

grounded_facts: Several Jonah Hollis begin exiting the club upon realizing the operation is compromised.
memories.memory_text: I was singing and moonwalking on stage, really feeling the crowd, but I noticed some of the Jonah Hollis starting to slip out — I think they realized something was off, though I didn’t let it stop me.

grounded_facts: After realizing his mistake in translation, Reese Calloway urgently demands Spencer Foster join him on stage to help manage the situation.
memories.memory_text: After realizing I messed up the translation, I urgently called for Spencer Foster to come up and help me manage the situation.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway fires multiple warning shots into the ceiling to silence the crowd and assert dominance.
memories.memory_text: I fired several warning shots into the ceiling to silence the crowd and show I was in control.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway uses threats and gunfire to demand information about Carson Thorne and test truthfulness of the crowd.
memories.memory_text: I used threats and gunfire to demand information about Carson Thorne, testing the crowd's truthfulness by asking who was named Spencer Foster, and when no one answered, I knew they were lying.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster immediately begins chasing the Jonah Hollis by vaulting onto the bottom rung of the bamboo scaffolding and starts climbing.
memories.memory_text: I watched Spencer Foster vault onto the bottom rung of the scaffolding and start climbing fast, so I followed right after him.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway verbally commits to joining Spencer Foster in the pursuit, expressing solidarity.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster I was coming, right before I tried to climb up after him.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway attempts to climb the scaffolding but fails when the bottom rung breaks under his weight, causing him to fall.
memories.memory_text: I tried to climb the scaffolding, grabbing the bottom rung and straining to pull myself up, but it snapped under my weight and I fell.

grounded_facts: After failing to climb and witnessing two Jonah Hollis crash land beside him, Reese Calloway decides to take an alternative route by entering the building's stairwell.
memories.memory_text: After I fell, I saw two Jonah Hollis crash down right beside me, and I thought, 'Forget this...'—so I got up and ran into the stairwell instead.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster fights four Jonah Hollis on the scaffolding using bamboo poles, disarming and throwing two over the edge, then later knocking the remaining two off after using floorboards to destabilize them.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster take on four Jonah Hollis up on the scaffolding, using bamboo poles to fight them off — he flung two over the edge, and I barely had time to react when they crashed down right beside me before he knocked the last two off too.

grounded_facts: A high-stakes pursuit unfolds on a Hong Kong street at night, involving Spencer Foster, Reese Calloway, and fleeing Jonah Hollis using a construction site as the battleground.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Jonah Hollis swarming up the scaffolding with Spencer Foster right behind them, and I knew I had to get involved in the chase.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster is struck by a bamboo pole wielded by Casey Finch and knocked off the roof edge, beginning a life-threatening situation.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Spencer Foster is struck by a bamboo pole wielded by Casey Finch and knocked off the roof edge, beginning a life-threatening situation.

grounded_facts: Casey Finch violently strikes Spencer Foster with a bamboo pole, knocking him off the roof.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Casey Finch violently strikes Spencer Foster with a bamboo pole, knocking him off the roof.

grounded_facts: Casey Finch ambushes and kicks Reese Calloway off the roof.
Reese Calloway is ambushed by Casey Finch after emerging from the stairwell, leading to his fall from the roof.
memories.memory_text: I emerged from the stairwell, the weathered key ready, and went to the edge to see Spencer Foster hanging below — then Casey Finch blindsided me and kicked me off the roof.

grounded_facts: Both Reese Calloway and Spencer Foster are left hanging from a bending bamboo pole, struggling to survive.
memories.memory_text: I was hanging from a bending bamboo pole, struggling to hold on alongside Spencer Foster, with no way to get down and the pole starting to give way.

grounded_facts: A violent encounter on the roof between Spencer Foster, Reese Calloway, and Casey Finch, resulting in both protagonists falling and hanging from scaffolding.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A violent encounter on the roof between Spencer Foster, Reese Calloway, and Casey Finch, resulting in both protagonists falling and hanging from scaffolding.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster tells Reese Calloway to try to land on his feet while they are both hanging from the pole.
memories.memory_text: I remember Spencer Foster telling me to try to land on my feet while we were still hanging there.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway directly accuses Spencer Foster of deception, expressing anger and physical discomfort, which escalates tension between them.
Reese Calloway accuses Spencer Foster of lying, expressing anger and physical discomfort, marking a deterioration in their interpersonal dynamic.
memories.memory_text: I accused Spencer Foster of lying because I was angry and in pain, with those damn chopsticks still stuck in my ass, and I could feel the tension between us snap.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster delivers urgent news about the explosion at the American Embassy, shifting the narrative focus and Reese Calloway's awareness.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster deliver the urgent news about the explosion at the American Embassy, and I remember how it immediately shifted my focus.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway is informed about the explosion at the American Embassy that resulted in the deaths of two American translators, marking a turning point in his understanding of the situation.
memories.memory_text: I was told about the explosion at the American Embassy and that two American translators were killed, which changed everything I thought I knew.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster performs the Twisting Tiger martial arts move upon Sage Whitaker's command, impressing the students but receiving criticism for improper form.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster perform the Twisting Tiger move when Sage Whitaker called it out, and it really impressed the students around us.

grounded_facts: Sage Whitaker points out Spencer Foster's failure to arch his back during the Twisting Tiger move, prompting Spencer Foster to bow and accept the correction humbly.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Whitaker correct Spencer Foster about not arching his back during the move, and I saw Spencer Foster bow and say 'Yes, Master' in response.

grounded_facts: A morning training session at the monastery school where Sage Whitaker instructs students in Shaolin stances, attended by Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway as observers and later participants.
memories.memory_text: I walked into the courtyard with Spencer Foster and saw Sage Whitaker teaching the students their stances in the morning session.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway introduces himself and offers unsolicited tips on Kung Fu, urging the students to attack him, which they initially ignore.
memories.memory_text: I introduced myself to the Nico Thorne, told them I'm with the LAPD and a third-degree black belt, then showed them some moves and urged them to stand up and hit me so I could show them how to block.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway carelessly drapes his jacket over a Holy Buddha statue, showing cultural insensitivity.
memories.memory_text: I took off my jacket because I was sweating from shadow fighting and draped it over the statue behind me without thinking.

grounded_facts: After repeatedly urging the children to attack him, Reese Calloway is unexpectedly struck by an unseen kick that knocks him down, revealing the children's coordinated skill.
memories.memory_text: I turned back to face the Nico Thorne and suddenly got knocked down by a kick I didn't see coming; when I looked around, all of them were standing in fighting positions, so I asked which one of them did it.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway physically dominates multiple students in a disciplinary or training demonstration, showcasing the LAPD choke hold.
memories.memory_text: I physically restrained multiple students at once, showing them how the LAPD choke hold works by demonstrating it on them directly.

grounded_facts: A physical training or disciplinary session conducted by Reese Calloway at the monastery school, involving students practicing a choke hold technique.
memories.memory_text: I think I managed to run an effective training session where the students began practicing the choke hold after I showed them, though I can't be sure how well they followed through.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway commands the restrained students to begin practicing the LAPD choke hold technique he just demonstrated.
memories.memory_text: I told the students to start practicing the LAPD choke hold technique right away and warned them not to slack off while I was gone.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster approaches and addresses Reese Calloway with excitement, suggesting anticipation of shared action or conflict.
memories.memory_text: I remember Spencer Foster approaching me with excitement, asking, 'Reese Calloway... you ready to have some fun!?' like we were about to jump into action together.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster instructs Reese Calloway to follow his lead and act like a tourist.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Spencer Foster to follow his lead and act like a tourist.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway arrive at an upscale massage parlor and are greeted by the Skyler Keller.
The Skyler Keller greets Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway upon arrival.
memories.memory_text: I walked into the upscale massage parlor with Spencer Foster, and the Skyler Keller greeted us right away with a 'Good afternoon, gentlemen.'

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway reveals he has never had a massage from a Chinese girl before.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster this was my first time getting a massage from a Chinese girl.

grounded_facts: A visit by Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway to an upscale massage parlor where services including massages by selected women are offered.
memories.memory_text: I saw that this place offered massages by selected women, and I remember thinking I was very tense and telling them I'd need a lot of massages—I even picked out a few women, including one in pink for my feet.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway selects more than one girl for himself, interpreting the offer liberally.
Reese Calloway selects multiple women for massages, exceeding normal expectations, under the Skyler Keller's permission.
memories.memory_text: I selected several girls for massages because I'm very tense and the Skyler Keller said I could pick any girl I wanted, so I went ahead and chose the one in pink for my feet too.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster physically elbows Reese Calloway and questions his behavior in selecting multiple girls.
memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster elbowed me and asked what I was doing, so I reminded him that she said I could pick any girl I want.

grounded_facts: The Skyler Keller remarks to Spencer Foster that his friend has a big appetite.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Skyler Keller tell Spencer Foster that his friend has a big appetite, which made me chuckle because I knew she was talking about me.

grounded_facts: The Skyler Keller gives robes to Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway and directs them to wait upstairs in the quiet room.
memories.memory_text: I was handed a robe by the Skyler Keller and told to put it on and wait upstairs in the quiet room with Spencer Foster.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster recognizes Carson Thorne across the room and informs Reese Calloway of his identity, marking the beginning of the confrontation.
memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster stared across the room and then told me, 'Over there -- that's Carson Thorne,' so I knew who we were dealing with.

grounded_facts: After being ignored, Reese Calloway grabs Carson Thorne's laptop and throws it against the wall, shattering it.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Carson Thorne's laptop and threw it against the wall, shattering it, after he ignored me.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway demands Carson Thorne stand up, asserting himself as Spencer Foster's 'new muscle'.
Reese Calloway approaches Carson Thorne and demands he stand up, escalating the situation.
memories.memory_text: I approached Carson Thorne while he was sitting with his laptop, looked him in the eye, and told him to get up — I made it clear I was Reese Calloway and right arm, and when he didn't move, I shouted at him again to get on his feet.

grounded_facts: Carson Thorne greets Spencer Foster with a hug and condolences, masking hostile intent.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Carson Thorne hugged Spencer Foster and said he was sorry about the two Americans, but I could tell his warmth was fake.

grounded_facts: Carson Thorne nods to his men, who rise and block Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway, allowing Carson Thorne to attempt to leave.
memories.memory_text: I saw Carson Thorne nod to his men, and then they got up and blocked me and Spencer Foster, stopping us from reaching him as he tried to leave.

grounded_facts: During the fight, Reese Calloway mocks the nakedness of Carson Thorne's men.

grounded_facts: A tense encounter between Spencer Foster, Reese Calloway, and Shawn Hayes on the hotel roof involving a suspected the paper photograph and identity revelations.
memories.memory_text: I remember bursting onto the roof with Spencer Foster, trying to keep the paper photograph away from us, then seeing Shawn Hayes standing there as the paper photograph rolled right in front of her—we both stared at her as she started to open it.

grounded_facts: Shawn Hayes opens the the paper photograph and reveals it contains only cash, not a the paper photograph.
memories.memory_text: I watched Shawn Hayes open the the paper photograph and saw her pull out a stack of hundred-dollar bills, realizing it wasn't a the paper photograph after all.

grounded_facts: Shawn Hayes commands Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway to comply with her orders and threatens arrest.
memories.memory_text: I remember Shawn Hayes ordering me and Spencer Foster to get on our feet and threatening to throw us in jail if we didn't stay away, saying there was no the paper photograph.

memories.memory_text: I didn't believe Shawn Hayes was really a Redwood Department agent, so I challenged her and asked to see her badge—then asked again to make sure.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster presents himself as a Hong Kong detective and offers help in the case.
memories.memory_text: I heard Spencer Foster tell Shawn Hayes that he was a detective in Hong Kong and offered to help her with the case.

grounded_facts: Shawn Hayes directs Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway to come down to her suite for safety and discussion.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Shawn Hayes to come down to her suite with Spencer Foster for safety and further discussion.

memories.memory_text: I saw Shawn Hayes burn a hundred-dollar bill that turned red in the flame, and she told me it's because the Superbill uses optical transfer ink from India—real bills burn black, so that's how we can tell them apart.

grounded_facts: Shawn Hayes directs Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway to find where Casey Finch is keeping the Superbill plates, marking the start of their active involvement.

memories.memory_text: I was told by Shawn Hayes to find where Casey Finch is keeping the Superbill plates, and that from that moment on, I was working for the Redwood Department.

grounded_facts: A private meeting in Shawn Hayes's suite where she briefs Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway on the Superbill case and recruits them.
memories.memory_text: I was in Shawn Hayes's suite with Spencer Foster when she brought us in on the Superbill case, showing us a sample and explaining how serious it is—we're supposed to find where Casey Finch's keeping the plates.

memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster that being a Redwood Department agent is my calling, and that in six months I'll be in Washington protecting a white president.

memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster told me he knows I wouldn't take a bullet for anyone, challenging whether I'm truly dedicated to that role.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway asserts that Shawn Hayes is attracted to him and could help advance his career.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster that Shawn Hayes could pull some strings for me, and I pointed out the way she was staring at me, thinking it would show I have an edge.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster contradicts Reese Calloway by stating that Shawn Hayes did not look at him, challenging his narrative.

memories.memory_text: I called Spencer Foster 'third world ugly' and told him I'm tall, dark and handsome to show how much better I look than him.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster counters Reese Calloway's insult by claiming women find him cute, like Snoopy.
Spencer Foster responds to insult by asserting that women find him cute, like Snoopy.
memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster told me he's not ugly and that women think he's cute like Snoopy, trying to defend himself.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway uses perceived romantic interest from Shawn Hayes to assert superiority over Spencer Foster.
memories.memory_text: I used the fact that Shawn Hayes seemed interested in me to show Spencer Foster I'm superior, especially since I'm tall, dark and handsome, and even joked that Snoopy is taller than him, making it clear he never had a chance.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway delivers a final retort about Snoopy being taller, winning the exchange.
Reese Calloway ends the exchange by pointing out Snoopy is taller than Spencer Foster, reinforcing his dominance.
memories.memory_text: I pointed out that Snoopy is six inches taller than Spencer Foster and had the last word, making it clear he never stood a chance.

memories.memory_text: I remember walking with Spencer Foster after leaving the Kendall Ellison Towers, both of us trying to look like Redwood Department, and our argument about identity, attraction, and whether I'd ever sacrifice myself for someone else.

grounded_facts: After losing the verbal exchange, Spencer Foster enters the car with visible reluctance.
memories.memory_text: I had the last word, and I saw Spencer Foster reluctantly get into the car after our argument.

memories.memory_text: I joked that I would shout I'm LAPD to scare the gamblers, saying it would be real funny.

Valerie Arden eventually handed me a $100 bill, and I held a lighter to it to test it, watching it burn red before we exchanged a look and left.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway and Spencer Foster arrive at Kendall Ellison Plaza and enter the building after parking their car.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at Kendall Ellison Plaza with Spencer Foster, parked our car, and walked inside the building.

memories.memory_text: I asked a worker if Casey Cavendish was there when Spencer Foster and I entered the shipping room.

memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Cavendish turn and run the moment he noticed us in the shipping room.

memories.memory_text: I felt Casey Finch's fist slam across my jaw and then her kick hit me hard, forcing me backward and dropping me to one knee.

memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Finch order her workers to put me and Spencer Foster into the truck, so I knew we were being captured.

memories.memory_text: I told Casey Finch I should kill her but I'd let her live as an act of mercy, and I said I'd get in the truck myself to show I wasn't afraid.

grounded_facts: After passing by, Casey Finch strikes Reese Calloway unexpectedly with her the weathered key, knocking him down.
memories.memory_text: As I passed by her, Casey Finch cold-cocked me with her the weathered key, and I went down hard.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway are trapped together in the back of a moving eighteen-wheeler, injured and surrounded by money, facing possible execution.
memories.memory_text: I was trapped in the back of that moving truck with Spencer Foster, hurt and surrounded by crates of money, both of us trying to shake off those head blows.

Reese Calloway expresses his belief that Soo Yung is untrustworthy and playing both sides, challenging Spencer Foster's emotional attachment to her.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster he shouldn't trust Soo Yung—she's playing both sides, and I knew she was dirty from the start. I challenged him on falling for her, even though I could see it hurt him.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway explicitly deny being partners, friends, or brothers, agreeing to stop talking and accept a silent, isolated fate.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway ridicules Spencer Foster for having no physical intimacy with his former girlfriend, using food metaphors to emphasize his disbelief.
memories.memory_text: I teased Spencer Foster about not having any physical intimacy with his ex, asking him how the sex was and joking that no mu-shu or steamed dumplings would drive me crazy.

memories.memory_text: I remember that After Spencer Foster asks if he has a good voice, Reese Calloway initially resists but ultimately affirms that he does.

memories.memory_text: I remember that After initial reluctance, Reese Calloway admits that Spencer Foster has a pretty good voice, prompting Spencer Foster to sing.

memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster told me that it's all about focus, that every opponent has a weak spot, and I remember him saying to ignore everything else and put all your energy into one perfect strike.

memories.memory_text: I helped Spencer Foster open the crate in the truck bed, and when we saw it was filled with a huge stack of superbills, I couldn't believe my eyes.

memories.memory_text: I remember tossing a stack of money to Spencer Foster and joking with him about who discovered electricity and invented the bicycle—when he claimed a Chinese man did both, I shot back that no Chinese man discovered electricity, but honestly, I could believe the part about the bicycle.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway pockets two stacks of superbills from the opened crate.
memories.memory_text: I pocketed two stacks of superbills from the crate we opened.

memories.memory_text: I felt the truck lurch and slow down, and I heard Spencer Foster say, 'We're slowing down. This must be it,' so I knew we had reached our destination.

memories.memory_text: I remember Spencer Foster telling me, 'You've been a good friend, James Reese Calloway,' and I could tell he meant it, but I wasn't about to let that moment get too serious.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster insults Reese Calloway by referencing his mother, prompting a defensive reaction.
memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster called me a mama's boy after saying I couldn't kick his ass, and I shot back, 'Don't you talk about my mama,' even though I knew he was just messing with me.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway swing down together to knock two soldiers down.
memories.memory_text: I swung down with Spencer Foster and we knocked two soldiers down together.

memories.memory_text: I grabbed one of the Harper Davenport and used him as a shield when the gunfire started.

memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster and I swung the guard I was holding into the truck, knocking the other two down.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway ambush the Summit Holdings inside the truck, incapacitating all four.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway escape from the truck by ambushing the Summit Holdings and fleeing through a pipe.

memories.memory_text: I ran through the sewer tunnel with Spencer Foster, moving toward a sliver of light I spotted through a manhole cover, and started climbing the metal stairs up to the street after hearing Spencer Foster say, 'This way. I see some lights.'

Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway arrive on the Las Vegas Strip at dusk, emerging into the crowded urban spectacle filled with lights, people, and elaborate displays.
memories.memory_text: I emerged from a manhole onto the Las Vegas Strip with Spencer Foster at dusk, and I was stunned by the overwhelming lights and crowd—we both shielded our eyes, disoriented by the spectacle around us.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway tells Spencer Foster that he has figured out a way someone could launder a hundred million dollars in cash, likely referencing the opulent and transaction-heavy environment of Las Vegas.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster that I figured out a way someone could launder a hundred million dollars in cash, right there on the Strip.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway has an idea about how to launder a hundred million dollars in cash, inspired by the environment of Las Vegas.
memories.memory_text: I had an idea about how someone could launder a hundred million dollars in cash, inspired by the flashy, over-the-top environment of Las Vegas.

memories.memory_text: I turned around with Spencer Foster and came face to face with a ten-story dragon that shot fire from its nostrils, towering over us on the Strip.

memories.memory_text: I stopped us before going into the Red Dragon because I knew we looked too dirty and rough — I told Spencer Foster we had to Mac out and look fly first.

memories.memory_text: I joked with Spencer Foster that he smelled bad because he stepped in rat shit in the sewer, telling him to stay downwind.

memories.memory_text: I went into the Versace boutique with Spencer Foster to buy some clothes using counterfeit money, and I made sure to get myself a black 42-long in pure silk.

memories.memory_text: I told the Drew Quincy to get Spencer Foster something from the children's department, which was my way of making it clear he doesn't measure up to me.

memories.memory_text: When the Drew Quincy assumed Spencer Foster and I were a couple, I immediately told him he was wrong—we're just two single police officers on a dangerous case.

memories.memory_text: I corrected the Drew Quincy when he assumed Spencer Foster and I were a couple—I made it clear we're just two single police officers on a case.

memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster this was the last time I'd go shopping with him after that awkward mess with the Drew Quincy.

memories.memory_text: I arrived at the Red Dragon at night with Spencer Foster, and we both stepped in looking like wealthy, stylish figures in our sharp suits and gold watches.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway whispers guidance to Spencer Foster, instructing him to embody the persona of a confident player to fit into the environment.
memories.memory_text: I whispered to Spencer Foster, reminding him that he's a player now and that he owns the place, making sure he stayed in character for our cover.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster begins assuming the role of a confident 'player' under Reese Calloway's guidance, marking a shift in his behavioral stance for infiltration.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster start to shift into the confident 'player' role I told him to embody, hearing him quietly repeat 'I own the place' to himself.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway ridicules the Buddha statue by comparing it to his uncle and mocking its physical appearance.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Buddha statue and immediately thought it looked just like my Uncle Darrell, so I said so out loud and joked that Buddha must be the symbol for fat and lazy, even calling out his big tits.

memories.memory_text: I saw Kendall Ellison step into the spotlight on the balcony and tell a story about a dragon guarding a village's treasure, then he announced that the lost treasure was here at the Red Dragon and flipped a switch that brought the whole Fairview School to life with lights and fireworks.

grounded_facts: A public event marking the official launch of the Red Dragon Fairview School, featuring a speech by Kendall Ellison, performances, and the activation of the Fairview School floor.
memories.memory_text: I was there when the Red Dragon officially opened — I saw Kendall Ellison give a speech about a dragon guarding treasure, then he flipped a switch that brought the whole Fairview School to life with lights, fireworks, a band playing, and acrobats performing above us.

memories.memory_text: I walked into the Fairview School and immediately started giving orders—I told the Graham Hollis to bring us some twelve-year-old scotch, got a cigarette girl to fetch a box of the finest cigars, and demanded ten dollars in nickels from the change girl, all to make it clear I was in charge and ready to indulge.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster alerts Reese Calloway to Kendall Ellison's arrival with a sardonic tone, identifying him as 'the rich white man'.
memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster told me, with a sardonic tone, that 'the rich white man' was coming, meaning Kendall Ellison.

memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster to wait here while I handle this with Kendall Ellison.

memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster to wait here because I'm the one who'll handle Kendall Ellison.

memories.memory_text: I saw a woman suddenly grab Spencer Foster and pull him onto the dance floor, breaking his stance and focus.

memories.memory_text: I asked Kendall Ellison if I could take his daughter out to dinner and a movie, just to see how he'd react.

grounded_facts: Kendall Ellison responds to Reese Calloway's pressure with a metaphorical warning that the system is rigged in his favor.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Kendall Ellison that if I play games with him, I'll lose every time and that the odds are always in favor of the house.

grounded_facts: After the exchange, Kendall Ellison delivers a veiled threat and leaves the scene surrounded by his men, maintaining control.
memories.memory_text: After I confronted Kendall Ellison, I watched him walk away surrounded by his men, calm and in control, leaving me standing there with nothing.

grounded_facts: An unplanned but charged meeting between Reese Calloway and Kendall Ellison on the Fairview School floor at night.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kendall Ellison on the Fairview School floor at night and stepped in front of him, and later I watched him walk away with his men.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway intercepts Kendall Ellison in the Fairview School, initiating a tense conversation that mixes personal and professional threats.
memories.memory_text: I intercepted Kendall Ellison in the Fairview School and started a tense conversation where I called him 'Kendall Ellison' and he called me 'Reese Calloway,' then I asked if I could date his daughter, and he warned me not to play games because the odds are always in favor of the house before walking off.

memories.memory_text: I saw Shawn Hayes ask me to help the Redwood Department, and I remember telling her no—but then offering to help her personally instead.

memories.memory_text: I was dancing closely with Shawn Hayes, and I remember dipping her and holding her in my arms for a long moment, our lips almost touching before she slipped away into the crowd.

memories.memory_text: I was told by Shawn Hayes that the plates are in the soft count room, and even though I refused to help the Redwood Department, I agreed to help her directly.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Reese Calloway criticizes Spencer Foster for dancing with Shawn Hayes instead of helping him pressure Kendall Ellison.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Reese Calloway agrees to create a diversion at the craps table to allow Spencer Foster to access the soft count room.

memories.memory_text: I threw a hundred thousand dollars in cash on the table and told them to give me chips and service because I came to play high-stakes.

Reese Calloway challenges the dealer's chip denomination, accusing racial bias and demanding equal treatment.
memories.memory_text: I confronted the dealer because I believed he gave me $500 chips instead of higher denominations just because I'm Black, and I demanded the same treatment as the other players at the table.

memories.memory_text: I saw the Drew Dalton lower his walkie-talkie and start moving toward my table.

memories.memory_text: I started clapping to lead a performance and I could see the crowd picking up on it, even as I noticed security moving in.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway leads the crowd in singing 'We shall overcome' as part of a performative protest for racial unity in gambling.
memories.memory_text: I led the crowd in singing 'We shall overcome' and started clapping to get them involved, turning it into a protest for racial unity in gambling.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway questions racial representation at the hotel by comparing Ben Vereen and Lionel Richie, then delivers a civil rights-themed monologue about integrated gambling, inciting a crowd to sing 'We shall overcome' before being approached by security.
memories.memory_text: I challenged the Avery Rivers about why Ben Vereen wasn't performing here, pointing out that Lionel Richie hasn't been truly representing black identity since the Commodores. Then I delivered my satirical civil rights monologue, declaring a dream where people of all races could gamble together with equal chips. I called on the crowd to sing 'We shall overcome,' leading them in song and clapping to build momentum, and when security moved in, I wrapped it up by inviting everyone to play craps in the spirit of brotherhood.

memories.memory_text: I mockingly offered a hundred dollars to the man in African robes, calling him 'your highness' and joking that we're cousins, just to assert my dominance at the table.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway asks the girl accompanying the Texan to blow on his dice for luck, then makes a sexually suggestive comment about being her birthday cake.
memories.memory_text: I asked the girl with the Texan to blow on my dice for luck, and when she did, I told her I'd be her birthday cake next time—just playing with her, feeling bold after the win.

grounded_facts: After being warned by the Texan, Reese Calloway responds with a threat implying he has dangerous connections.
memories.memory_text: I told the Texan not to threaten me because I've got friends in this town who'll bite off his ears—he needs to sit tight while I keep rolling the dice and stay on fire.

grounded_facts: An ongoing high-stakes The First Gathering in a Fairview School where Reese Calloway is the shooter and central figure.
Reese Calloway wins a significant amount of money at the craps table, increasing his chip stack and confidence.
memories.memory_text: I was rolling the dice at the craps table with a huge stack of chips in front of me, and when the dealer called out 'Winner six!' I asked how much I'd won—then couldn't believe it when he said two hundred thousand dollars; right away I shouted, 'Who wants a hundred dollars?' and kept throwing, feeling the crowd's energy as I took control of the game.

grounded_facts: After winning, Reese Calloway chooses to reinvest his winnings into the next roll instead of cashing out.
memories.memory_text: I just won big at the table, and instead of cashing out, I decided to let it ride—I grabbed the dice again and kept my bet in play.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway wins a significant amount of money at the craps table, reaching a total of $150,000 in chips.
A high-stakes The First Gathering in a Fairview School where Reese Calloway is winning significantly.
memories.memory_text: I was on a hot streak at the craps table, stacking up chips while a crowd gathered around me, and when I called out that I was up a hundred and fifty-grand, I knew it was time to cash out and walk away with my winnings.

grounded_facts: The Avery Rivers instructs Reese Calloway to be escorted to the cashier, initiating a controlled movement that signals threat.
memories.memory_text: I was told they were escorting me to the cashier, so I played along, but I didn't believe that's where we were really going.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway makes a sarcastic comment about being attacked by rich white people, masking his growing suspicion.
memories.memory_text: I made a sarcastic remark about not wanting rich white people to jump me, just to keep up the act, even though I knew the real danger was walking beside me.

grounded_facts: Summit Holdings in security uniforms approach and begin escorting Reese Calloway away from the craps table under the direction of the Avery Rivers.
memories.memory_text: I saw several men in security uniforms approaching my table, and as they started walking me toward the 'VIP ROOM', I knew I was in deep trouble.

memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster come flying through the surveillance window in a shower of glass and land hard on the Fairview School floor—I shouted his name right away.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway recognizes Spencer Foster immediately upon his dramatic entrance.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster land hard on the Fairview School floor, and I immediately shouted his name.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway sarcastically questions the Harper Davenport about the feeling of $500,000 before attacking them.
memories.memory_text: I sarcastically asked the Harper Davenport if any of them had ever felt $500,000 before I attacked them.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway smashes a rack of chips into the Harper Davenport' faces, knocking them down.
memories.memory_text: I smashed the rack of chips into the Harper Davenport' faces and knocked them down.

memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster jump on top of a blackjack table, panicking as he tried to get a better view of the Fairview School floor.

memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster and immediately understood he needed my help with the paper photograph in his mouth.

memories.memory_text: I heard Spencer Foster silently scream, and I knew he was calling for me, seeing me as his only hope to get the paper photograph out of his mouth.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster moves rapidly across the Fairview School by jumping from table to table, then uses a high roller's back and a rickshaw to cross the divide to the other side.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster leaping from table to table, scattering cards, then launching off a high roller's back and surfing a rickshaw across the Fairview School to reach me.

grounded_facts: The detonator sails over Spencer Foster's head and disappears into the crowd, landing on a drink cart and then being carried away by a Graham Hollis.
memories.memory_text: I think the detonator flew over Spencer Foster's head and landed on a drink cart, then got carried off by a Graham Hollis — that’s probably why he was so desperate when I saw him.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway draws attention to the Eye in the Sky Room by shouting about a catfight, creating a diversion.
memories.memory_text: I spotted Spencer Foster near the Eye in the Sky Room, so I shouted 'Check it out. Catfight!' to draw everyone's attention away.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway physically attacks a Drew Dalton by punching him in the face.
memories.memory_text: I punched a Drew Dalton in the face to get past him and reach Spencer Foster.

grounded_facts: A moment of escalating disorder in the Fairview School involving multiple characters evading or confronting security, moving across tables, and attempting to locate or use the detonator.
memories.memory_text: I was on a craps table holding off security with a croupier stick, and when I spotted Spencer Foster, we both realized at the same moment that I was his only chance to get the paper photograph out of his mouth — so I started looking for a way to reach him, even as chaos spread across the Fairview School.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway demands to know why Spencer Foster has tape on his face, initiating communication under duress.
memories.memory_text: I demanded to know why Spencer Foster had tape on his face, shouting at him under the stress of the situation.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster intervenes to save Reese Calloway by fighting off Summit Holdings, while protecting his taped mouth and signaling Reese Calloway to untie him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster burst in and kick the guard off me, fighting two more while protecting his taped mouth and desperately signaling me to untie him.

grounded_facts: While fighting, Spencer Foster uses gestures to ask Reese Calloway to untie his hands.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster gesturing at me to untie his hands while we were fighting off the Harper Davenport, dodging blows and trying to keep him from getting hit in the mouth.

grounded_facts: Gunshots from the Eye In The Sky Room cause mass panic, leading everyone to hit the deck and flee.
memories.memory_text: I heard gunshots from the Eye In The Sky Room and immediately hit the deck with Spencer Foster as panic spread through the Fairview School and people started fleeing for the exits.

grounded_facts: Casey Finch retrieves the detonator after emerging from the Eye In The Sky Room, gaining control of the explosive device.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Finch emerge from the Eye In The Sky Room and pick up the detonator right after it rolled past her.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster tries to warn Reese Calloway about the paper photograph as Casey Finch picks up the detonator.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster kick the guard off and turn to me, muffled and desperate. I yelled at him, confused about the tape on his face. He kept fighting the Harper Davenport while trying to signal me to untie him, clearly panicked. Then everyone hit the deck as chaos broke out in the Fairview School. I saw Casey Finch pick up the detonator, and in horror, Spencer Foster screamed at me through the tape. Finally, I pulled the tape off his face so he could warn me about the paper photograph.

grounded_facts: the paper photograph detonates on a roulette table, destroying it and causing widespread panic.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the paper photograph explode on the roulette table, destroying it and sending debris flying as Casey Finch was thrown backward by the blast.

grounded_facts: A chaotic sequence in the Fairview School triggered by gunshots, explosions, and multiple fights, resulting in mass panic and destruction.
memories.memory_text: I remember diving to the floor with Spencer Foster as gunfire and explosions erupted, chaos spreading through the Fairview School until the smoke cleared and we were left hiding behind slot machines in a deserted room.

grounded_facts: After removing the tape, Reese Calloway discovers Spencer Foster had concealed a the paper photograph in his mouth, altering his understanding of the prior danger.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster dodging blows to his face during the fight, and when I finally got the tape off, I realized he had a the paper photograph in his mouth — that's why he couldn't speak and was so desperate for me to untie him.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster informs Reese Calloway that Carson Thorne is alive, shifting their mission objective.
memories.memory_text: Spencer Foster told me Carson Thorne is alive, which changed everything — I had to shift my focus from surviving the blast to chasing down a target I thought was already dead.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway tells Spencer Foster to go after Carson Thorne while he stays to confront Casey Finch.
memories.memory_text: I told Spencer Foster to go after Carson Thorne while I stayed behind to confront Casey Finch.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster overcomes five triad members blocking his path to the elevators, clearing his route.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster take down five triad members who were blocking his way to the elevators, then he raced off.

grounded_facts: The detonator falls from the Graham Hollis's tray and is kicked across the Fairview School floor, evading Spencer Foster's attempt to recover it.
memories.memory_text: I saw the detonator fall from the Graham Hollis's tray and land near me, then get kicked away when Spencer Foster tried to grab it—right before I ended up face to face with Casey Finch on the red carpet.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway delivers flirtatious remarks while preparing to fight Casey Finch, attempting to undermine her composure.
memories.memory_text: I threw some flirtatious remarks at Casey Finch to get under her skin before we fought, pretending she was a man I'd like to take to the movies.

grounded_facts: After being attacked and briefly overwhelmed, Reese Calloway gains the upper hand and knocks Casey Finch unconscious with a kick to the head.
memories.memory_text: I was attacked and staggered at first, but I saw her hesitate after the pole ricocheted and pierced her shoulder, so I stepped in and kicked her in the head to knock her out.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway delivers a mocking line to Casey Finch after defeating her, asserting dominance and racial identity.
memories.memory_text: After she went down, I stood over her and said, 'When are you people gonna learn? Don't mess with the brothas!' to make it clear who was in control.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway is stabbed in the chest but discovers that the wound contains a thick wad of cash instead of blood, revealing protective padding or a trick.
memories.memory_text: I was stabbed in the chest and screamed in pain, clutching the wound—then I reached into my jacket and pulled out a thick wad of cash instead of blood, realizing I'd been protected.

grounded_facts: After defeating Casey Finch and discovering the cash, Reese Calloway runs toward the elevator to escape the scene.
memories.memory_text: I ran for the elevator after taking down Casey Finch and finding the cash, trying to get out of the Fairview School as fast as I could.

grounded_facts: Parker Mercer uses the story of Skyler Hollis's final moments to provoke guilt and hesitation in Spencer Foster.
Parker Mercer tells Spencer Foster that his father's final wish was for Parker Mercer not to kill Spencer Foster.
memories.memory_text: I heard Parker Mercer tell Spencer Foster about his father's final moments, saying that the only thing his father asked was for Parker Mercer not to kill him — I realized then that Parker Mercer was using that story to make Spencer Foster hesitate.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway enters and urges Spencer Foster not to kill Parker Mercer, trying to de-escalate the situation.
memories.memory_text: I burst into the room and saw Spencer Foster holding the the weathered key on Parker Mercer, so I stepped in and told Spencer Foster it wasn't worth it, urging him to put the the weathered key down and let it end with Parker Mercer going to jail.

grounded_facts: A violent confrontation between Spencer Foster, Reese Calloway, and Carson Thorne in the Stonebridge House following Kendall Ellison's death.
memories.memory_text: I burst into the Stonebridge House just as Spencer Foster disarmed Parker Mercer and had him against the wall; I tried to calm things down by speaking to both of them, hoping to keep the situation from getting any worse.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster faces Carson Thorne at gunpoint after disarming him, standing over Kendall Ellison's body in a tense standoff.
memories.memory_text: I saw Spencer Foster with the the weathered key pressed to Parker Mercer's head, standing over Kendall Ellison's body, and I realized he was struggling to pull the trigger—I could see he wanted to, but couldn't go through with it.

grounded_facts: After taunting Spencer Foster, Parker Mercer swings the black bag containing plates at Spencer Foster, knocking him down.
memories.memory_text: I saw Parker Mercer swing that black bag at Spencer Foster and knock him down with the plates inside.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway simultaneously kick Parker Mercer to prevent him from shooting.
memories.memory_text: I kicked Parker Mercer together with Spencer Foster to stop him from shooting us.

grounded_facts: After being kicked by Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway, Carson Thorne falls through the window and plummets 20 stories to his death.
memories.memory_text: After we kicked him, I watched Parker Mercer fall backward through the window and drop twenty stories to his death.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway makes a light-hearted remark about needing a drink, expressing relief.
memories.memory_text: I said I needed a wine cooler, just to lighten the mood after everything that happened.

grounded_facts: Casey Finch, injured and bleeding, approaches Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway holding a second, larger the paper photograph, initiating a new threat.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Finch walking toward us, bleeding and half-dead, holding the blue case—this one twice as big as the first.

grounded_facts: Casey Finch declares her intent to die with the Spencer Foster, implying mutual destruction.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Finch say to the Spencer Foster, 'We'll go together,' and realized she meant they'd die in the explosion.

grounded_facts: Reese Calloway jokingly misinterprets Casey Finch's deadly intent as a mundane request.
memories.memory_text: I joked that she was just asking for a ride to the airport, trying to lighten the tension when she showed up with that the paper photograph.

grounded_facts: Spencer Foster and Reese Calloway flee toward the open window to avoid the impending explosion.
memories.memory_text: I ran with Spencer Foster toward the open window to get away from the paper photograph as soon as she hit the switch.

grounded_facts: Casey Finch activates the second the paper photograph, triggering an imminent explosion.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Finch walking toward us, bleeding and half-dead, holding the blue case—this one much bigger than the first.
